responsibility: This definition file is the master table of D intrinsics known to the compiler. For each intrinsic it records the internal enum code, corresponding GCC builtin where applicable, frontend-visible name, owning module, mangled signature decoration, and whether it is CTFE-only, providing the shared source used to generate intrinsic enums, matching logic, and builtin expansion metadata.
same_name_distinction: This file is the data table for the intrinsics pair: it enumerates each recognized intrinsic's code, module/name, signature decoration, builtin mapping, and CTFE-only status, while intrinsics.cc uses that table to recognize declarations and perform lowering/expansion.
